chdman WebAssembly, built from MAME commit
27a8d9e85b58058965907d1d8a7a92f8ed039348 with Emscripten 6.0.2.

Binary provenance:
https://github.com/Kelvao/RetroShrink/tree/11ae4215e47ee4f10197608e22e166016e814fb0/public
Original chdman.js SHA-256:
358e7b1c953f5960e44701775403debac40685bead91191c24a6b8d0374152db
Original chdman.wasm SHA-256:
da1d4a57af54c47e3069bb0af84144e465d98bfc2ea2c10f9e0fead3be081eda

Local modification (2026-11-02): the WebAssembly memory section's initial
and maximum sizes are both increased from 259 to 2048 pages (128 MiB).
The original 16 MiB allocation fails during CD extraction. Code sections
are unchanged. tools/resize_chd_memory.py reproduces this modification.

chdman.cpp is copyright Aaron Giles, BSD-3-Clause. MAME's individual files
and bundled libraries carry their own licenses; see licenses/ and the
source headers. MAME as a whole is GPL-2.0. No RetroShrink frontend code
is included. upstream-build.yml records the upstream build procedure.

source.tar.gz includes the exact MAME tool, utility, platform, build and
third-party source trees, excluding the unrelated BGFX graphics renderer.
Original source:
https://github.com/mamedev/mame/tree/27a8d9e85b58058965907d1d8a7a92f8ed039348
